exposure: Pentaglobin(r) as adjuvant therapy (5 ml/kg daily for 3 consecutive days)
cohort: A cohort of 272 premature and very low birth weight neonates diagnosed with sepsis in neonatal intensive care units.
finding: Pentaglobin(r) adjuvant therapy was associated with a significantly shorter disease duration and a substantially decreased risk of death compared to standard antibiotic treatment alone in premature and very low birth weight neonates with sepsis.
